title: It's 2026. Who Still Uses a Weighted Average?
title_zh: 都 2026 年了,谁还用加权平均?
summary: I forecast daily volume for a cross-border e-commerce sorting warehouse with a 30-line EWMA plus day-of-week bias calibration. It beat every baseline (7.5% vs 12.3% MAPE) and keeps finish-time estimates within half an hour. A case for matching the tool to the problem in the LLM era.
summary_zh: 我给一个跨境电商分拣仓做日单量预测:30 行 EWMA 加按星期几的偏差校准,跑赢所有对照(MAPE 7.5% 对 12.3%),收工时间预估误差半小时以内。写给大模型时代的一个反方向案例:工具要配问题。

title: Designing /sync-docs: A Cross-Project Knowledge Base for Claude Code
summary: A Claude Code slash command I designed to turn 311 scattered markdowns across 30+ projects into one cross-session memory file. The design decisions: what to deduplicate, how to pick a canonical copy, why context.md is capped at 2000 lines, why staleness is 90 days.
